svg.title: Main language of 28 public repositories
svg.desc: JavaScript 14, CSS 4, HTML 4, TypeScript 3, C++ 1, Go 1, Python 1. Main language as detected by GitHub, one count per repository; forks, repositories without code and the profile repository are excluded. Snapshot 11 Oct 2026.
